summary: Requires 2,640 feet (one half mile) of separation from urban residential zones and noise-sensitive uses and 1,000 feet from commercial and office zones, plus a 40-foot enhanced landscape border. Notice goes to owners within one half mile and neighborhood associations within two miles.
notes: Resolves the half-mile vs 40-foot question in coverage: these are two separate provisions. KOLD's '40-foot buffer around each facility' is the landscape border, not the separation distance.
confidence_note: Figures are from the May 28 2026 proposal fact sheet. The adopted ordinance (O12268) PDF is a scan with no text layer and has not been read; the adopted page describes 'enhanced separation distances' without figures. Confirm against the adopted text after OCR.
instrument: Tucson Ordinance O12268, Large-Scale Data Centers UDC amendment
